data_origin: TSE official 2024 detail_by_section and section_vote datasets; two rounds and section keys

checkpoint_grid.diagnostic: every integer 1 through 100 percent of SECOND TURN sections first totalized
checkpoint_grid.ordering: first internal recorded 2T totalization timestamp reaching each percentage; no future sections included
checkpoint_grid.ties: all first section totalization events with same timestamp are observed simultaneously
checkpoint_grid.availability: assumed availability_at=internal timestamp, not contemporaneously captured public availability

holdout_decision: Require 5 of 5 cases meet all primary criteria; any missing source/case remains BLOCKED and counts as failure, do not replace cases.
interpretation_limits: New municipalities unused in V6 development provide external historical holdout only, not blinded prospective independent certification.
Public outcomes for these elections were already knowable before selection; choice of cases can bias generalization.
Checkpoints reconstructed from final section votes and first-totalization clocks, not authenticated public incremental snapshots.
Data and model owner are the same; independence of review is not established.
19 checkpoint metrics per municipality are correlated; independent statistical unit is election.
